claims.statement: This is a GRADE guideline with PICO-structured questions, supported by the first formal network meta-analysis in a CD guideline
claims.evidence_excerpt: **Scope:** Adult outpatients with moderate to severe luminal CD (CDAI ≥220 or high-risk features per IOIBD criteria) and perianal fistulizing CD. Surgical management, TDM, and postoperative prophylaxis are excluded — the latter is a notable gap compared with ACG 2018.
